mapper.select: SELECT SUMMARY_ID AS summaryId, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, SUMMARY_TEXT AS summaryText, REVIEW_COUNT AS reviewCount, LAST_REVIEW_UPDATED_AT AS lastReviewUpdatedAt FROM review_summary WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviewCount, MAX(UPDATED_AT) AS lastReviewUpdatedAt FROM review WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
SELECT CONTENT FROM review WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND CONTENT IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CONTENT) != '' ORDER BY REVIEW_ID DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_summary ( PRODUCT_ID, SUMMARY_TEXT, REVIEW_COUNT, LAST_REVIEW_UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{summaryText}, #{reviewCount}, #{lastReviewUpdatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE review_summary SET SUMMARY_TEXT = #{summaryText}, REVIEW_COUNT = #{reviewCount}, LAST_REVIEW_UPDATED_AT = #{lastReviewUpdatedAt}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
